PROJECT.ONCELLEDITED: update proizvodi set oznaka = '@@Oznaka', opis = '@@opis' where proizvodiid = @@ID #select 'refresh' as mastergrid
PROJECT.NAME: Projekt
PROJECT.CAPTION: Ažuriranje recepture

INPUT.NAME: orgshemaid
INPUT.SQL: select orgshemaid, naziv from vismjene o order by sortkey
INPUT.CAPTION: Orgshema

INPUT.NAME: skladisteid
INPUT.SQL: select skladisteid, oznaka + ' ' + opis as Sklad from skladiste
INPUT.CAPTION: Skladište

FILTERFORM.NAME: FILTERFORM
FILTERFORM.CAPTION: Filter
FILTERFORM.ONSUBMIT: select p.proizvodiid, p.Oznaka, r.UserId as Šifra, r.Naziv as Roba, o.Naziv as Orgshema, s.Opis as Skladište, kl.naziv as Klasifikacija, kl.sortkey as Sort, p.Opis as Opis2000, p.Retired as Umirovljen from Proizvodi p inner join Roba r on r.RobaId = p.RobaId left outer join OrgShema o on o.OrgShemaId = p.OrgShemaId left outer join Skladiste s on s.SkladisteId = p.SkladisteId inner join klmasterroba kl on kl.klmasterrobaid = r.klmasterrobaid where p.Tip = 0 /*and isnull(retired, 0) = 0*/ and (p.robaid = @@robaid or @@robaid is null) and (r.klmasterrobaid = @@klmasterrobaid or @@klmasterrobaid is null) order by r.UserId --

ZAMJENI.NAME: ZAMJENI
ZAMJENI.CAPTION: Form
ZAMJENI.ONSUBMIT: update proizvodi set oznaka = opis, opis = oznaka where proizvodiid = @@ID

PREBACIOPIS.NAME: PREBACIOPIS
PREBACIOPIS.CAPTION: Form
PREBACIOPIS.ONSUBMIT: update proizvodi set opis = oznaka where proizvodiid = @@ID
